text:
emily: FRA customs flagged AWB GBH-900-321. infra says EU pool will feel it if units are delayed. can vendor confirm routing + any standby/insurance concessions?
nova-ops: we have three options: (A) immediate air split up to 8 units (48h) + remainder sea (+6 days) with air premium $2k/unit; (B) consolidate to sea only (+9 days) with 70% credit on depot standby/handling; (C) cross-dock via nearby DE hub (adds +2 days) with lower air premium $1.2k/unit and we absorb duty reclass fees. need PO sign.
rafa: ops heads-up: depot dock is back-to-back Tue/Thu. staging available but limited. temporary staging (max 12 units) ok for 10 days. cost below.
rafa: ```
staging 10d: $200/day area + $130/unit handling
expedite handling (air split): $95/unit
```
shipment-bot: Carrier: AWB GBH-900-321 status = "Docs incomplete". ETA window +30h.
sam: if shipment arrives without serial manifest we must issue temp IDs and reconcile in receipt. that'll be ~1.5 FTE-days. quarantine triggers after 72h.
emily: vendor: is 70% credit guaranteed? could you cap standby exposure instead if we take the cross-dock option?
nova-ops: 70% credit is conditional on delivery photos + depot invoice within 48h. alternate: we cap standby at $6k if you commit to cross-dock within 1h.
sam: procurement: we can absorb $2k air up to 8 units. beyond that need stepped discounts. can you run quotes for 8/16/24 air splits vs cross-dock?
nova-ops: doing brackets now, posting numbers.
devex-bot: Reminder: staging policy requires serial reconciliation within 72h or units move to quarantine. Temp-ID CSV accepted.
nova-ops: bracket quote: 8 air = +$16k (incl expedite); 16 air = +$29k; 24 air = +$42k. Cross-dock option reduces total premium ~20% vs full air.
emily: thanks. tagging finance offline. @sam please confirm if we can take 10-unit staging Tue-Wed. also need explicit RMA SLA to avoid duplicate depot charges.
sam: we can accept staging for up to 12 units TueWed but OT billing applies. RMA SLA request: vendor must pick DOA within 4 business days to avoid depot credit disputes.
nova-ops: confirmed: RMA pickup SLA = 4bd, photo-first triage accepted. we'll attach terms in booking. booking cross-dock now pending your PO.
emily: propose decision: cross-dock (lower premium), vendor cap standby $6k, we accept +$16k if air for 8 units only. staging accepts 10 units; RMA SLA 4bd. objections?
sam: procurement ok with that conditional on bracket confirmation in writing.
rafa: ops note: send temp-ID manifest if serials missing and CC depot photo checklist. we'll prepare short recon runbook.
nova-ops: will send AWB for cross-dock leg + updated sea ETA in ~90m and attach T&Cs. :white_check_mark:
emily: thanks everyone. please attach vendor confirmation of standby cap and RMA SLA to PO amendment. :pray:
